summary: A three-minute recruiting 1-1 between Chris Klevan (Primal Instinct) and Tyler Barry, a closer candidate. Tyler opens by withdrawing: his current employer, vShred, counter-offered 14% commission plus weekly KPI bonuses, so he is staying. Chris does not attempt to counter-sell, states he cannot match the offer, wishes him well and leaves the door open. No coaching offer, prospect or sales content appears anywhere in the call.
notable: Competitor comp benchmark on the record: the candidate says vShred agreed to '14% commission plus weekly bonuses if I hit a number in KPIs'.
Chris declines to compete on pay at all — 'I can't make you an offer consistent with that' and 'I'm not going to convince you otherwise' — a de facto statement of the closer comp ceiling.

Candidate is warm and pre-sold on the brand ('I've been binge watching all your guys' videos') and explicitly invites a re-approach if vShred lead flow dries up; this is a re-open candidate, not a dead one.
The candidate cites a family situation ('everything with my father's going on') as part of why he needs certain money.
Misfiled: the transcript sits in the Andrew Musial rep folder but Andrew is not a participant.
Diarization is inverted — the '(Primal Instinct)' suffix is attached to Tyler, the external candidate, not to Chris. Roles here were resolved entirely from content.
